name: Speko
description: Answer and place phone calls, then read transcripts and recordings.

methods.whenToUse: Use the provider-hosted connection for the quickest setup.
methods.guidanceMd: Create a Speko API key at https://platform.speko.ai/api-keys, then paste it here. A Speko key belongs to one Speko organization, so the key is the boundary: use a key from an organization that holds only the agents and phone numbers these agents may reach. Keep approvals on, because calls cost money and reach real people.
